segments.name: IB-Stim
segments.description: Develops and sells neuromodulation devices for gastrointestinal disorders and related conditions using percutaneous electrical nerve field stimulation technology.
segments.evidence: Based on an evaluation of these factors, management concluded that the Company's operations are managed through one reportable segment, IB-Stim, that derives its revenues in the United States from a PENFS device that is used to treat patients 8-21 years of age with functional abdominal pain associated with irritable bowel syndrome and in patients 8 years and older with functional abdominal pain associated with functional dyspepsia and related nausea symptoms.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase FDA-cleared neuromodulation devices and related treatment procedures reimbursed by insurance carriers and government programs.
revenueModel.evidence: The CODM uses net sales to evaluate IB-Stim's adoption and utilization by insurance carriers and physicians.

dropped: change not grounded: In 2025, the Company terminated the NSS-2 Bridge license with Masimo Corporation
